title: Update rings are assigned to user groups rather than device groups
when: it.Assignments.Any(a => a.TargetType == 'AllUsers') || it.Assignments.Any(a => Facts.Groups.Any(g => g.Id == a.GroupId && g.MembersKnown && g.MemberCount > 0 && g.DeviceMemberCount == 0))

report.title: {Items.Count} update {Plural(Items.Count, 'ring is', 'rings are')} targeted at users

messages.businessImpact: Update behaviour follows the person rather than the machine, so a shared or unattended device may follow whichever schedule its last user brought with them.
remediation: Retarget update rings to device groups.
messages.cannotSee: Whether a group holds users or devices is worked out from the members that were read: a group with members, none of which is a device, is taken to be a user group. A group whose membership could not be read is not judged, and neither is an empty one, since an empty group says nothing about what it was meant to hold.
